card_description:
**Priority:** P0 | **Location:** London/US (Dual HQ) | **AUM:** $60M+

**Investment Thesis:**
Global seed-stage gaming fund focused on game studios, platforms, and infrastructure. Strong thesis on live service tools and analytics for game developers. Thesis-driven investor seeking early-stage opportunities in games and digital entertainment.

**Why They're a Good Target:**
- Just invested in Live Aware Labs (Oct 2024) - game analytics/observability platform showing active appetite for infrastructure tools
- Shanti Bergel is a 30-year gaming veteran (ex-Disney, ex-EA) with deep operator credibility
- Seed-stage focus aligns with our stage and check size
- Recent fund close (~$60M Fund II in 2022) means fresh capital and active deployment
- Dual London/US presence offers timezone flexibility and European market access

**Key Partners:**

| Name | Title | Background | Priority |
|------|-------|------------|----------|
| Shanti Bergel | Founding General Partner | 30-year gaming veteran, ex-Disney/EA, founded Doppio Games | PRIMARY |
| Mika Kuusisto | Partner | Ex-Next Games, mobile gaming specialist | SECONDARY |

**Portfolio Companies (Recent):**
- Live Aware Labs ($4.8M Seed, Oct 2024) - Game analytics/observability
- Gardens (2024) - Game studio
- Mythical Games - Blockchain gaming

**Warm Path Opportunities:**
- None identified directly - cold outreach recommended
- Potential: Live Aware Labs portfolio company connection (if relevant to your network)
- Gaming conference circuit: Shanti speaks at major events (GDC, Gamescom)

**Recommended Outreach Angle:**
**Subject:** Seed-stage [Game Analytics/Infra] - [Company Name]

**Hook:** Lead with live service tools thesis alignment. Reference their Live Aware Labs investment as validation of market timing. Shanti responds to operator credibility - emphasize technical depth and game industry experience.

**Key Talking Points:**
1. Live service game infrastructure is underserved at seed stage
2. Direct competitor/adjacent to Live Aware Labs validates market
3. Technical team with shipped game titles (if applicable)
4. London/EU gaming ecosystem angle (if relevant)

**Contact Information:**
- Shanti Bergel: shanti@transcend.fund | LinkedIn: /in/shantibergel
- Website: https://www.transcend.fund
- Fund: Active, deploying Fund II

**Research Sources:**
- https://www.transcend.fund/team
- https://www.crunchbase.com/person/shanti-bergel
- VentureBeat: Transcend closes $60M Fund II (Oct 2022)

**Next Action:** Send personalized cold email to Shanti Bergel emphasizing live service infrastructure thesis alignment.
checklist: Research Shanti Bergel recent talks/media appearances
Send cold email with live service infrastructure angle
Follow up if no response in 7 days
